questions.question: A car starts from point A towards point B, travelling at the speed of 20 km/h. 1(1)/(2)hours later, another car starts from point A and travelling at the speed of 30 km/h and reaches 2(1)/(2)hours before the first car. Find the distance between A and B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of speeds = 20 : 30 = 2 : 3

Ratio of time taken = 3 : 2 (since distance is constant)

Difference in time ratio = 3 − 2 = 1 unit

Total time difference = 1.5 hours (late start) + 2.5 hours (early arrival) = 4 hours

⇒ 1 unit = 4 hours, so time taken by Car 1 = 3 × 4 = 12 hours

Distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 12 = 240 km

**∴ The correct answer is 240 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Car 1 (S₁) = 20 km/h

Speed of Car 2 (S₂) = 30 km/h

Car 2 starts 1.5 hours later and reaches 2.5 hours earlier.

 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 Point A
 Point B

• 
 Total Distance = D km

 
 
 Car 1: 20 km/h
 Time = t hrs
 

 
 
 Car 2: 30 km/h
 Time = t − 4 hrs
 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Difference in time = Late start time + Early arrival time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total distance between A and B be D km.

⇒ Time difference = 1.5 hours + 2.5 hours = 4 hours.

⇒ Time taken by Car 1 − Time taken by Car 2 = 4 hours

⇒ (D ÷ 20) − (D ÷ 30) = 4

⇒ (3D − 2D) ÷ 60 = 4

⇒ D ÷ 60 = 4

⇒ D = 60 × 4 = 240 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 240 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Distance Formula

When travelling the same distance at two different speeds S₁ and S₂ with a known total time difference Δt, Distance = (S₁ × S₂ ÷ |S₁ − S₂|) × Δt.

Average Speed

If a vehicle covers equal distance segments at two different speeds S₁ and S₂, the Average Speed over the entire journey = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their Relative Speed is the difference of their speeds (S₁ − S₂). If they move in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).
</p

questions.question: The difference between a discount of 25% and two successive discounts of 15% and 10% on a certain bill was Rs. 25. Find the amount of the bill.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Single Discount = 25%

Successive Discount = 15% and 10%

Difference = Rs. 25

**Calculation: **

Let the bill amount be Rs. 100x.

Case 1:

25% discount to the 100x = 25x discount

Price after discount = 100x - 25x

⇒ 75x

Case 2:

Discount of 15% to the 100x = 15x

Price after discount = 100x - 15x

⇒ 85x

Second Discount of 10% to the 85x = 8.5x

Price after the second discount = 85x - 8.5x

questions.question: The nearest number which is greater to 87501, and is completely divisible by 765 is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the remainder of 87501 when divided by 765.

Remainder = 87501 (mod 765) = 291.

To find the next greater divisible number, add (Divisor − Remainder) to the number.

Required Number = 87501 + (765 − 291) = 87501 + 474 = 87975.

**∴ The correct answer is 87975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original Number = 87501

Divisor = 765

**Formula Used:**

Smallest number greater than N divisible by D = N + (D − (N mod D))

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divide 87501 by 765 to find the remainder:

⇒ 87501 ÷ 765 = 114 with a remainder of 291

⇒ 765 × 114 = 87210 (largest divisible number less than 87501)

⇒ The next divisible number = 87210 + 765

⇒ Required number = 87975

⇒ Verification: 87975 ÷ 765 = 115 (exactly divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 87975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility and Remainders

When a number N is divided by D, the remainder R always satisfies 0 ≤ R < D. To make N divisible by D, one can either subtract R from N or add (D − R) to N.

Divisibility Rule for Composite Numbers

For a number to be divisible by 765, it must be divisible by its prime factors. Since 765 = 3² × 5 × 17, the number must be divisible by 5 (ends in 0 or 5) and 9 (sum of digits is a multiple of 9).</p

questions.question: Rs. 5,000 is divided into two parts such that if one part is invested 4% and the other at 5%, then the whole annual interest from both the sums is Rs. 223. How much was invested at 4%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rs. 5,000 is divided into two parts such that if one part is invested 4% and the other at 5%

The whole annual interest from both sums is Rs. 223

**Calculation:**

Let the 1st investment be Rs x

So, the 2nd investment = Rs. (5000 - x)

According to the question,

x × 4/100 + (5000 - x) × 5/100 = 223

⇒ 4x/100 + 250 - 5x/100 = 223

⇒ 250 - 223 = 5x/100 - 4x/100

⇒ 27 = x/100

⇒ x = 2700

So, 1st investment was Rs. 2700

**∴ The required answer is Rs. 2700.**

questions.question: Ruchi, Khushi and Teju can do a piece of work in 30, 40 and 60 days respectively. In how many days can Ruchi do the work, if she is assisted by both Khushi and Teju on every third day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ruchi can do the work in 30 days

Khushi can do the work in 40 days

Teju can do the work in 60 days

**Formula used:**

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 120 units [As LCM of 30, 40, 60 is 120]

So, efficiency of Ruchi, Khushi, Teju = 4, 3, 2

Now,

In 3 days total work completed = 4 + 4 + 9

⇒ 17 units of the work

In 21 days total work completed = 17 × 7

⇒ 119 units

Now remaining 1 unit will complete Ruchi in 1/4 days

So, total time = 21 + 1/4

⇒ (85)/(4) days

**∴ In (85)/(4) days the work will be completed.**

questions.question: The area of a sector of a circle is 66 cm² and the angle of the sector is 60°. Find the radius of the circle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Area of Circle = Area of Sector × (360° / θ)

πr² = 66 × (360 / 60) = 66 × 6 = 396 cm²

r² = 396 ÷ (22/7) = 396 × (7 / 22) = 18 × 7 = 126

r = √126 = √(9 × 14) = 3√14 cm

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of sector = 66 cm²

Angle of sector (θ) = 60°

Value of π ≈ 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = (θ / 360°) × πr²

 
 

 60°
 Area = 66 cm²
 
• 
 r = ?
 Sector of a Circle

**Calculations:**

⇒ 66 = (60 / 360) × (22 / 7) × r²

⇒ 66 = (1 / 6) × (22 / 7) × r²

⇒ 66 = (22 / 42) × r²

⇒ r² = (66 × 42) / 22

⇒ r² = 3 × 42

⇒ r² = 126

⇒ r = √126

⇒ r = √(9 × 14)

⇒ r = 3√14 cm

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of Arc

The length of the arc of a sector is given by l = (θ / 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The perimeter includes the arc length plus two radii: P = l + 2r = [(θ / 360°) × 2πr] + 2r.

Area of Circle

The total area of a circle with radius r is A = πr².

Area in terms of Arc Length

If the arc length l is known, the area of the sector can be calculated as A = (1/2) × l × r.</p

questions.question: If (cos q + sin q) = 31/25, then what will be the value of cos² q?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

(cos q + sin q) = 31/25

**Concept used:**

Sin²θ + Cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

(cos q + sin q) = 31/25 -----(i)

⇒ (cos q + sin q)² = (31/25)²

⇒ cos² q + sin² q + 2cosqsinq = 961/625

⇒ 1 + 2cosqsinq = 961/625

⇒ 2cosqsinq = 961/625 - 1

⇒ 2cosqsinq = 336/625

Now,

(cos q - sin q)2 = cos2 q + sin2 q - 2cosqsinq

⇒ (cos q - sin q)2 = 1 - 336/625

⇒ (cos q - sin q)2 = 289/625

⇒ (cos q - sin q) = 17/25 ----(ii)

From eq (i) and eq (ii) we get,

2cos q = 48/25

⇒ cos q = 24/25

So, cos2 q = (24/25)²

⇒ 576/625

**∴ The required answer is 576/625.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

**Concept Used:**

Sinθ = Opposite/ Hypotenuse(O/H)

Cosθ = Adjacent/ Hypotenuse(A/H)

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

⇒ cos q + sin q = 31/25

⇒ A/H + O/H = 31/25

⇒ (A + O)/H = 31/25

So we get, H as 25 and (A + O) = 31

Now we know a triplet as 7, 24, and 25

This satisfies the given condition, 

Using the values, we get, 

Cos q = A/H = 24/25

So, cos2 q = (24/25)2

⇒ 576/625

∴ The required answer is 576/625.

questions.question: The average marks of 60 students in a class are 62. The average marks of boys and girls in that subject are 60 and 65, respectively. The number of boys in the class is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By using the Alligation method, we can directly find the ratio of boys to girls.

Ratio of Boys to Girls = (Girls Average − Overall Average) : (Overall Average − Boys Average)

Ratio = (65 − 62) : (62 − 60) = 3 : 2

Total parts = 3 + 2 = 5 parts = 60 students ⇒ 1 part = 12 students.

Number of boys = 3 parts = 3 × 12 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of students in the class = 60

Overall average marks of the class = 62

Average marks of boys = 60

Average marks of girls = 65

**Formula Used:**

Total marks = Average marks × Number of students

 
 Boys
 
 60

 
 Girls
 
 65

 
 Average
 
 62

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 
 3
 65 - 62

 
 
 2
 62 - 60

 
 Ratio = 3 : 2

**Calculations:**

Let the number of boys be B and the number of girls be G.

⇒ B + G = 60

⇒ G = 60 − B

Total marks of all students = Total marks of boys + Total marks of girls

⇒ 62 × 60 = (60 × B) + (65 × G)

⇒ 3720 = 60B + 65(60 − B)

⇒ 3720 = 60B + 3900 − 65B

⇒ 65B − 60B = 3900 − 3720

⇒ 5B = 180

⇒ B = 180 ÷ 5 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

Alligation is a quick technique to find the ratio in which two components are mixed. The ratio is determined by taking the cross-difference of individual averages from the overall mixture's average.

Weighted Average Formula

When two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ have averages A₁ and A₂ respectively, the combined average is given by: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Net Deviation Method

In any valid dataset, the total sum of deviations of all group items from their true combined average must equal zero. This property allows solving without multiplying large values.
</p
